notes: Willy Guggenheim (offlane) has no kill or death credited in this fight; assists aren't tracked per fight, so presence is unknown — the lane read says pinned, so the fight was the wrong call regardless.
We took Fangtooth in the same window — read it as a trade, not a clean loss.
They traded the fight for Mini Prime across the map — we won bodies but gave the objective.
Their main damage was The Fey (32k magical); 0/5 of us itemized magic resist — that hurt.
Enemy ran 4/5 on or near their meta core — they drafted and built optimally; match it.

draftNote: 3 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane), Cuban Noobster (jungle→carry), Willy Guggenheim (offlane→jungle).

coaching.headline: A clean win that leaked four majors: both enemy Mini Primes and the Genesis Core at 24 fell with Argus or Skylar dead, and the Genesis Core at 17 went uncontested with all five of us alive.
coaching.team: We won on structures and objective damage: 8 towers to 3, and 70,194 objective damage to their 19,550. The early game was messier than the score. Skylar took first blood on Grux at 2.4, then donated three solo deaths to Grux before 10.3. Argus was caught alone by The Fey at 9.6. The river went 16 to 8 their way; both their Mini Primes and the Genesis Core at 24 fell with one of us already dead, and the Genesis Core at 17 went uncontested with all five of us alive. The fight at 8.3, lost 1-3 at our Fangtooth, was a trade: we had just taken the Fangtooth. From 20.1 on nothing was close: won 4-0 at our Fangtooth, then fights won 3-2, 3-1 and 3-1, each followed by a tower. Primal Fangtooth at 26 and Orb Prime at 27 closed it. Nine fights won, six cashed. Vision was ours, 36 wards to 23. Next game: no solo deaths before minute 10 in the offlane or mid; two of them, Argus at 9.6 and Skylar at 10.3, handed over Mini Prime at 11.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The fight at 20.1, won 4-0 at our Fangtooth with everyone alive on both sides, was the turn: Fangtooth fell to us at 20.3 and two outer towers followed inside two minutes. From there every fight was won and the towers kept falling.
coaching.whatWorked: Scarlett's jungle: 34,342 objective damage, the most on either team, and the 2-0 pick on Bayle and GRIM.exe at 11.1 at their Mini Prime.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Maco was in the fights. 5 kills and 13 assists on 32 team kills, 16,452 healing, 21,267 damage mitigated, 10 wards placed and 4 cleared, the most cleared on the team. One death, at 8.4 inside the lost fight at our Fangtooth, not a solo catch. Four of the five kills came after 26, when the game was already won.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Kira farmed to damage and stayed alive: 35,468 hero damage, the most in the game, 12,162 objective damage, one death. That death at 8.5 was inside the lost fight at our Fangtooth, not a solo catch. GRIM.exe died to her three times.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett ran the map: 34,342 objective damage, the most in the game, in a jungle that was ours against Boris all game. The 2-0 pick at 11.1 on Bayle and GRIM.exe was traded for their Mini Prime, the right trade when their carry and support die for it. Two deaths, neither solo. No armor against three physical damage dealers.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Skylar won the lane on kills and donated it on deaths. First blood on Grux at 2.4, a second kill before minute 5, then three solo deaths to Grux before 10.3, their Mini Prime taken while she was dead. Seven kills say the hero was fine; the three solo deaths were the leak.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Argus produced 9 kills from a lane that was theirs on paper, and three of his five deaths opened something. Caught alone by The Fey at 9.6 and by GRIM.exe at 16.3; three enemy majors and three towers fell with Argus dead first. 3 wards, fewest on the team.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Eighteen of 32 team kills, 16,452 healing and 4 wards cleared: the support was in the fights.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: Most hero damage in the game, 35,468, on one death is the carry job done.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.text: Most objective damage in the game, 34,342, in a jungle owned all game; two deaths, neither solo.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: Two kills on Grux by 4.6, then three solo deaths to him before 10.3: an offlane donated after being won.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: Nine kills, but three enemy majors fell with Argus dead first, and two solo deaths outside any fight.

20.1.call: Won 4-0 at our Fangtooth with everyone alive, then Fangtooth at 20.3 and two outer towers by minute 22. This is the template: fight on top of our own objective with five up, then take the structures the fight opens.

24.1.call: Won 3-1, yet gave up the Genesis Core at 24 and an inner tower at 24.7 with Argus dead. After winning a fight a body down, clear the jungle objective first; Primal Fangtooth at 26 was the right follow-up.

26.1.call: Fought 3-1 at their inhibitor two items down, 9 to 11, and won it; the inhibitor fell right after and Orb Prime at 27. The call was right: Primal Fangtooth was already ours, so pushing with it was the win.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Off the core (no Crescelia, Enra's Blessing or Windcaller) and it did not cost a fight after 8.4: Hexbound Bracers, Gaia Greaves and Everbloom bought health and heal power, and the only lost fight was the one where Boris caught Scarlett and Maco at our Fangtooth. Nothing else to teach.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Maco.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Tainted Rounds and Ruination instead of Solaris and Ashbringer bought anti-heal and burst over cooldown refunds; against a lineup with no healer the anti-heal slot was spare, and 35,468 damage on one death says the game never tested it.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis pays out on every third straight basic attack on the same hero, which fits Kira's stack-and-shred kit into Grux and Boris, and trades away the burst an item-scaling Demiurge would give.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: No armor against three physical damage dealers (Manta Scythe, Malady, Earthshaker, Infernum), and two deaths, both to Boris and Grux inside fights, so the game never punished it.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Thraex marks whoever Scarlett last hit for more damage dealt and less taken, a duelist fit for a jungler who picks one target deep in the enemy jungle, and gives up the raw health Krix would bring.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: The three solo deaths to Grux came before the first item was online (Vanquisher, estimated minute 12), so the build had no part in them; after that, 7 kills on Vanquisher, Deathstalker, Tainted Rounds and Terminus, off the Plasma Blade and Imperator half of the core.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vermis rewards three straight basic attacks on the same hero, which fits Skylar's on-hit, hover-and-shoot kit into a Grux who kept diving her, and trades away the item-scaling Demiurge burst.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: On the Azure Core, Entropy, Wraith Leggings core with Overseer fourth; nothing to teach here.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vesh turns every ability hit into a burn over time, the fit for a poke mage stacking damage from max range, at the cost of any durability against The Fey's 32,092 magic damage.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
ourKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
ourKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
ourKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
ourKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
enemyKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
enemyKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel
